notes.title: Momodora: Reverie Under the Moonlight version 1.07 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. A new update for Momodora: Reverie Under the Moonlight is [b]soon to be out [/b]in the coming days, fixing a few issues and adding quality of life improvements to the game. When the update is released, please confirm the bottom right of the title screen reads "v1.07". The list of change is as follows:

- Fixed an issue where the final boss hitbox would be active between phase transitions
- Fixed an issue allowing the player to get a Crest Fragment and transition to another screen without triggering the cutscene
- Fixed a continuity error related to the NPC "Eri" when she appears in Karst City
- Improved visibility of item sparkles
- Improved visibility of Ivory Bugs
- Improved visibility of Pardoner Fennel's jump attack effect
- The Bellflower at the start of the game is now automatically equipped when you obtain it
- The Bellflower before the Moka boss fight was moved closer to the shortcut
- Ring of Candor now "beeps" several times when a secret is nearby
- Misc. audio improvements
- The third bow charge level now does much more damage
- Adjusted the colors of the Cat ability
- Bells are now displayed by a bell icon in the map, instead of a yellow square
- Adjusted the spawn location for the enemy in the room where you fight Frida, making it easier to complete Pacifist runs

That's all for this update. Thank you very much for your continued support. :momozzz:

- rdein

Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif[/img]

Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: In commemoration of the Touhou Luna Nights Ver. 1.0 Update - Introducing the PLAYISM Metroidvania Bundle!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

On February 26th (Tue.), Touhou Luna Nights - which was available on Early Access - was updated to Ver. 1.0! To commemorate this milestone update, we're releasing a bundle of PLAYISM's popular Metroidvania titles.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10320/PLAYISM_Metroidvania_bundle/]■PLAYISM Metroidvania_bundle[/url]

We hope you enjoy this batch of beloved Metroidvania titles, proudly brought to you by PLAYISM. Each one is a true gem, painstakingly crafted and tailored for players of all kinds, from total beginners to action game veterans to straight-up masochists. If you're a Metroidvania fan, then you'll love each and every title in this lineup.

[h1]Touhou Luna Nights[/h1]
The latest title from Team Ladybug, developers of a wide variety of action games. Take on the role of maid "Sakuya Izayoi", who possesses the power to control time and who has been sent against her will to a strange, mysterious world by her mistress, "Remilia"... Touhou Luna Nights features beautifully detailed sprite animation and the "grazing" system - specially tweaked for action games - for which the "Touhou Project" is known.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763087/92cbb23040c79f777dac387e8aac82affd272469.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763087/6273e7cf103ab31ed7ac54d91f08d9c3df97cda4.gif[/img]

[h1]Momodora: Reverie Under The Moonlight[/h1]
Momodora: Reverie Under The Moonlight is the fourth installment in the beloved Momodora series of 2D platformers. Unleash ravaging combos against a variety of formidable monsters and deftly dodge your way through a cursed land to seek audience with the Queen and dispel the evil that threatens all life.

[h1]LA-MULANA[/h1]
LA-MULANA is an “Archaeological Ruin Exploration Action Game,” bringing the classic appeal of adventure with the punishing difficulty of retro-inspired gaming. Search inside ancient ruins, seeking out the “Secret Treasure of Life” – which sleeps in the sprawling ruins of “LA-MULANA” and is said to be the beginning of all civilization. Unfortunately, priceless artifacts very rarely give themselves up easily.

[h1]LA-MULANA2[/h1]
The long-awaited sequel to La-Mulana, La-Mulana 2 follows Lumisa Kosugi as she explores the ancient ruins of La-Mulana. Desperate to find the cause of the recent slew of monsters appearing from the ruins, Lumisa discovers the "other" La-Mulana: the ruins known as Eg-Lana.

notes.title: 2018 Patch Update - version 1.06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a while since I posted an announcement here myself. This time around it's for the changes on the latest released patch. 

[h1]They are as follows:[/h1]

[list][*]Boss drop items are now cancelled only if you take damage during the fight (including self-damage, and poison).
[*]Easy difficulty adjustments: starting HP was changed to 48, and now Vitality Fragments add up to your HP until a maximum of 80. Previously, you started with 80 HP and Vitality Fragments didn't do anything. For a comparison, Normal difficulty starts with 30 HP, and Hard with 15.
[*]Higher HP absorption when using Red Ring or Torn Branch (7% of your maximum HP per enemy kill, compared to a fixed amount of 1 HP per kill previously).
[*]Added an effect to the first Bellflower tree to make its presence clearer.
[*]Added some minor shaking effect to the death animation of characters that have cat ears.
[*]Added a new anger effect to Alraunes.
[*]Added a new dialogue line to Cotillard for when you meet a very specific condition.
[*]Added some new dialogue to Prudence the Cat (that's the cat at the castle) as a hint for the True Ending.
[*]Updated the Bad Ending to make it clearer.
[*]Updated the item description for the Fresh Spring Leaf, as well as the text for the event where you get that item.
[*]Updated some tutorial text and the difficulty select text to make them clearer.
[*](PC/OSX/Linux) Updated Xbox 360 controller prompts to Xbox One controller prompts.
[*]Changed the level design in a few rooms to make the platforming less annoying to traverse.
[*]Changed the position of the "dodge" tutorial message slightly.
[*]Changed the screenshake effect for Fennel's thunder attack.
[*]Changed character interactions with NPCs/in cutscenes. Now Kaho turns back to human if you talk to NPCs as a cat.
[*]Improved text localization for some languages (retranslations, typos, etc.)
[*]Improved Moka's colors slightly.
[*]Removed collision damage from the horizontal movement attack of the final boss.
[*]Fixed a rare bug that could lock the player inside a boat.
[*]Fixed a screen transition in the Park area that could lead to a softlock depending on how you traversed it.
[*]Fixed some missing graphic in one area of the frozen forest segment.[/list]


In case there's anything wrong with this update, please don't hesitate to get in contact with me to notify me of an issue.
As usual, thank you all for your continued support and for being an amazing community!

To close things off, me and Bombservice have been working on a new game, quite similar in style to Momodora RUtM, nicknamed "Nundora" for the time being. We should have an official announcement for this new game soon :) I hope you will be looking forward to it. Until then!

Cheers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/428550/Momodora_Reverie_Under_The_Moonlight/

notes.title: 4.16.2018 Mac & Linux Update
notes.notes:
Hi All

Thank you for waiting. 
Also, sorry for the delayed release notes.
We have updated the Mac and Linux Builds for Momodora: Reverie Under the Moonlight. 

[h1]Updates:[/h1]
[list][*]Added a setting in the config.ini file to enable manual gamepad selection. There are two variables; GamepadID and AutomaticGamepadDetection.
(You can find "config.ini" or save data from "Home > .config > MomodoraRUtM" in Linux, and
"/Users/(username)/Library/Application Support/com.bombservice.momodorarutm" in Mac)

[quote]AutomaticGamepadDetection="0.000000"
Only 0 or 1.
0: default value. The game will automatically detect the gamepad.
1: The game will detect the gamepad assigned with "GamepadID".

GamepadID="0.000000"
The value will differ depending on your PC.
On the 360 controller, you might be able to identify the number from the light indicator on the Xbox button.
But generally, we couldn't a the way to identify the ID. You need to connect your gamepad, and change the value of "GamepadID" until it works.[/quote]

[*]Fixed the screenshot issue.
[*]Fixed the achievement issue[/list]

If you run into any issues, please let us know [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/428550/discussions/0/2860219962082753445/]in the Mac/Linux thread on the  Steam Forums.[/url]


We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Quick update about the "black screen" issue
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ːmomocatː
I just updated the game with a very small change, hopefully to fix the "black screen when fullscreen" issue that many players had lately.
What this update does is simply run the game with vsync enabled the [b]first time you boot it. If you have this issue and the game was already installed prior to this update, you will have to follow the steps below.[/b]

By default, that option was disabled. I ran some tests with our community members and I was told enabling vsync fixed this problem. Previously, we had a workaround using Windows 8 compatibility mode, but I fully understand that's a hassle for the players.

In case you'd like to disable vsync for some reason (it can possibly cause problems with streaming/recording of the game), or if you want to enable it to fix this issue without having to mess with compatibility mode, you can do so like this:

1) Open the "config.ini" file at the folder Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\MomodoraRUtM

"YourUserName" should be replaced by whatever the username in your computer is.

2) Change the "vsync" line to either vsync="0" or vsync="1".
To disable it, leave it at 0. To enable it, leave it at 1.

3) Save the changes and restart the game.

[b]Newer installations from now on that generate a new config.ini file will have vsync enabled by default, which should solve this issue.[/b]

Please post a message in case there are any issues with this change and I'll look into it as soon as I can.
I'd also like to apologize for figuring out this quite late. I was not aware vsync was the root of the problem, or it would have been fixed much sooner. Shoutouts to the folks at Vlambeer for giving me this tip :>

That's all for now. Once again, sorry for the inconvenience! ːrmomoː

notes.title: Version 1.04 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Here's a new version update for Momodora: RUtM. This version brings some changes to improve player experience. 

Changelog for version 1.04:
[General]
-Reduced the intensity of the "red flash" effect when the player is hurt. The death animation flash effect also was reduced.
-Made some changes to the room where you get the "Cinder Key" item.
-Added more details to the cutscene after the Whiteleaf Park boss battle. 
-Added a new visual cue for the dash recharge.
-Made some input changes related to climbing ladders.
-Swapped Confirm/Cancel controller input for japanese players.
-Decreased the volume of the dagger reflection sound effect.
-Added extra antecipation frames to Fennel's jump attack animation.

[Enemies]
-"Bat Head" enemies now only spawn when you are the edge of a screen, and always at the opposite side of where you are.
-You can now attack fire on the ground to put it out. It also won't hurt you if it's started fading away.
-Reduced the damage done by fire a little bit.
-Added more visual cues to Lubella's ground attack.
-Reduced the screenshake in Lubella's air attack.
-Made some changes to the pillar-spawning attack from the Heretical Arsonist, increasing the deacceleration of the balls when they get close to you. The pillars also spawn closer to the position where the balls stopped.
-The Heretical Arsonist now has a longer cooldown after throwing the teleport balls.

See you next time!

-Made some input changes related to climbing ladders.
-Swapped Confirm/Cancel controller input for japanese players.
-Decreased the volume of the dagger reflection sound effect.
-Added extra antecipation frames to Fennel's jump attack animation.

[Enemies]
-"Bat Head" enemies now only spawn when you are the edge of a screen, and always at the opposite side of where you are.
-You can now attack fire on the ground to put it out. It also won't hurt you if it's started fading away.
-Reduced the damage done by fire a little bit.
-Added more visual cues to Lubella's ground attack.
-Reduced the screenshake in Lubella's air attack.
-Made some changes to the pillar-spawning attack from the Heretical Arsonist, increasing the deacceleration of the balls when they get close to you. The pillars also spawn closer to the position where the balls stopped.
-The Heretical Arsonist now has a longer cooldown after throwing the teleport balls.

That's it for now. See you next time!

-Updated the Sacred Ordalia Grove background music.
-Changed the confirm/cancel input back to the way it was for japanese players.

Another quick hotfix patch to fix two issues that have been found:
-Fixed a collision issue in the latter "swinging platform" room in the Subterranean Grave area. The level design of this room was also retouched up a little bit. 
-Added more checks to the final boss' hitbox, as I received a bug report that her hitbox could vanish during one of her attacks. Hopefully the issue is fixed now.

notes.title: Version 1.02c update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here's a new update to the game. Mostly some fixing of rare bugs and some changes to the balancing of some enemies.

Changelog (version 1.02c):

[Balancing]
-Reduced the damage done by the regular Radish enemies.
-Added a visual cue for jumping Imp Girl's attacks.
-Jumping Imp Girls wait at least 2 seconds before attacking again.
-Some changes to the Bloodstained Tissue effect: now it hits twice per orb, and the homing behavior was changed to a fixed pattern.

[Bug Fixes]
-Fixed a bug where you couldn't change the game's language if you returned to title screen when a dialogue box was open.
-Fixed a crash that happened when you talked to Magnolia after her dialogue was already over.
-Fixed a bug where the map screen would remain active during the Game Over screen.

[Misc]
-Improved some visual effects.

notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
We are bringing a new patch to the game, fixing some things and prettying up some other things. Also, adding a new language option to the game!

-Fixed an issue with the Spike Balls at the Cinder Chambers.

notes.title: Custom Binds Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are bringing a new update to Momodora: Reverie Under the Moonlight. 
[b]The main feature is the option to change the keyboard's default keys via the Settings menu.[/b] This is a feature that was requested by many players, so we are bringing it to you! Please tell us if this update breaks something!


Changelog for version 1.01c:

[b][General][/b]
-Added the option of customizing keyboard keys (Settings -> Customize Keys). 
[b]Update:[/b] fixed a bug where Shift wouldn't bind correctly. Now Shift is the default menu key, but you can bind it to something else if you want! The previous default was Enter, in case you haven't changed that.
-Made it so you can move the map with the right analog stick. 
-Some very minor audio changes at the end of the Forest area. 
-Fixed a few typos. 

[b][Balancing][/b]
[spoiler]-Increased HP of all Final Bosses, along with their damage output and poison resistance.
-Final boss cannot be stunned anymore.
[/spoiler]

notes.title: News about version 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This update is about a small patch we are releasing now. It mostly covers some minor issues.

[b]We are aware of a major issue of the game, when it doesn't launch properly or it launches but nothing is displayed.[/b] We have contacted Yoyogames (the makers of the engine we use) and we are working to provide a definitive solution for those who have this issue as soon as possible! [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/428550/discussions/0/412448792354668960/]If you are having this problem, I recommend checking this thread where we listed some potential solutions.[/url][/b]

Here's the changelog for version 1.01:

[b][General][/b]
-Added a fan translation, German, courtesy of Pumalarios! Thank you!
-Added controller vibration options to Settings menu.
-Fixed some typos.
-Some minor level design changes.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
-Killing the wolves/dogs in the Frida fight shouldn't interfere with the Pacifist achievement anymore.
-Fixed a transition bug in one of the underwater sections of the Subterranean Grave.
-Fixed a softlock in a room of the Royal Pinacotheca area.
-Fixed a mistake in NG+ that allowed you to have two Rotten Bellflowers.
-Adjusted the collision of the Forest elevator.


That's it for now!
